model.title: Railroad Retirement Board Stability Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Bill Cassidy (R-LA)

summary.text: The bill would create a new administrative account within the Railroad Retirement Board to help manage its finances and operations more effectively. It seeks to improve the board's administrative capacity and financial stability through this organizational change.
